# llr_datum_spice — independent oracle output for the real-campaign LLR datum

Generated by `gen_llr_datum_spice.py` (this directory) on 2026-10-01. Consumed by
`tests/validate_llr_datum_spice_oracle.rs`, whose header is the pre-registration
(commit 6b27964a).

## Inputs

Only files already committed under `tests/fixtures/lunar_llr/` (ILRS CRD normal points,
IERS ITRF2020 stations, JPL DE430 Table 7 reflectors; see that directory's NOTICE.md).

## History

The first run of the generator used a midnight-rollover rule that added a day to any
record earlier than its session's `h4` start. Its pre-stated self-check (SPICE
observed-minus-computed RMS under 100 m) failed at 163.5 km, caused by one record listed
467 s before the start of an out-of-order session. That run's datum figures were seen
(translation sigma 1.835464e-2 m) before the rule was changed to "nearest the session
start"; no tolerance changed.
